preconditions.description: Number of vertices V is between 1 and 10^5.
Number of edges E is between 1 and 10^5.
The adjacency list has exactly V elements.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= u < V for u in range(V) for v in adj[u])
preconditions.description: All vertices in the adjacency list are within the range [0, V-1].

preconditions.expression: all(u == v for u, v in zip(range(V), sorted(range(V))))
preconditions.description: Vertices are labeled from 0 to V-1.

postconditions.description: Each critical connection is represented by a list of two vertices.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= u < V and 0 <= v < V for u, v in return_value)
postconditions.description: All vertices in the critical connections are within the range [0, V-1].

postconditions.expression: all((u, v) in return_value or (v, u) in return_value for u, v in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each critical connection is represented in sorted order (u, v) where u <= v.

postconditions.expression: all((u, v) != (v, u) for u, v in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each critical connection is represented without duplicate vertices (u, v) != (v, u).

postconditions.expression: all(any((u, v) in return_value or (v, u) in return_value for u, v in adj[i]) for i in range(V))
postconditions.description: Each vertex is part of at least one critical connection.
